card.name: Articles before harm or injury terms
card.fires_on: The small word "a" or "the" right after a verb or preposition, where the next word is likely a harm term such as a wound, reduced volume, or cause of death. Also one case on "Holocaust" in a museum name.

modes.label: Article before injury or cause
modes.description: "a" or "the" just before a noun describing a wound, a deficit, or a cause of death.
modes.example: died of a gun-shot wound to<< the>> chest at the age of 23

modes.label: Article in warning text
modes.description: "a" in label warnings about risk, before a condition or leading cause.
modes.example: There is increased risk in patients whose ability to maintain blood pressure has already been compromised by<< a>> reduced blood volume or concurrent administration of certain

modes.label: Holocaust museum name
modes.description: The word Holocaust inside a museum name.
modes.example: the United States Memorial<< Holocaust>> Museum, where she saw her name listed

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words for bathing, explosion, injury and lightning, so the output effect is only loosely about injury or blast.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "a" or "the" when a word about injury, harm or a cause of death is coming next.
